# spatial-structures.library: BuildOctree

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Builds an octree over a point set: the root is the smallest cube
> containing the points, an overfull node partitions its range into the
> eight octants around its center (stably, so source order survives within
> an octant), and splitting stops at maxDepth (clamped to at least 0) or
> when a range fits maxLeafSize (clamped to at least 1). Every internal
> node carries all eight children, empty octants as empty leaves; items
> land only in leaves. The depth cap is what guarantees termination when
> coincident points cannot be separated.

## Signature

```plato
BuildOctree(points: Array<Point3D>, maxDepth: Integer, maxLeafSize: Integer): Octree3D
```

### Law_OctreeChildrenAreConsecutiveAndPresent

[stdlib/tests/spatial-structures.laws.plato, line 88](../../../../../stdlib/tests/spatial-structures.laws.plato#L88)

```plato
// Every internal node's eight children exist in the node array.
Law_OctreeChildrenAreConsecutiveAndPresent(points: Array<Point3D>): Boolean
{
    var tree = points.BuildOctree(8, 4);
    return tree.Nodes.All(n => n.FirstChild.Value < 0
        || (n.FirstChild.Value > 0 && n.FirstChild.Value + 8 <= tree.Nodes.Count));
}
```

### Line 933

```plato

    // Builds an octree over a point set: the root is the smallest cube
    // containing the points, an overfull node partitions its range into the
    // eight octants around its center (stably, so source order survives within
    // an octant), and splitting stops at maxDepth (clamped to at least 0) or
    // when a range fits maxLeafSize (clamped to at least 1). Every internal
    // node carries all eight children, empty octants as empty leaves; items
    // land only in leaves. The depth cap is what guarantees termination when
    // coincident points cannot be separated.
    BuildOctree(points: Array<Point3D>, maxDepth: Integer, maxLeafSize: Integer): Octree3D
    {
        var n = points.Count;
        var depthCap = maxDepth.Greater(0);
        if (n == 0)
        {
            return (Point3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0).CenteredBounds(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                new List<OctreeNode>().Freeze(), new List<ItemIndex>().Freeze(), depthCap);
        }
        // Point extents through the Bounds3D-Bounds3D Union, for the same
        // backend-overload reason as in BuildBvh.
        var pointBounds = Bounds3D(points[0], points[0]);
        var b = 1;
        while (b < n)
        {
            pointBounds = pointBounds.Union(Bounds3D(points[b], points[b]));
            b = b + 1;
        }
        var halfSize = ((pointBounds.Max.X - pointBounds.Min.X)
            .Max(pointBounds.Max.Y - pointBounds.Min.Y)
            .Max(pointBounds.Max.Z - pointBounds.Min.Z)) * 0.5;
        // The union with the exact extents absorbs the floating-point dust the
        // centred cube can shave off its far faces, so every point is inside.
        var root = pointBounds.Center.CenteredBounds(halfSize, halfSize, halfSize)
            .Union(pointBounds);
        var leafSize = maxLeafSize.Greater(1);
        var perm = new Buffer<Integer>(n);
        var i = 0;
        while (i < n)
        {
            perm = perm.Set(i, i);
            i = i + 1;
        }
        var nodes = new List<OctreeNode>()
            .Add(OctreeNode(root, SpatialNodeIndex(-1), IntegerInterval(0, 0)));
        var stack = new List<IntegerVector4>().Add(IntegerVector4(0, 0, n, 0));
        var top = 1;
        while (top > 0)
        {
            top = top - 1;
            var frame = stack.At(top);
            var node = frame.X;
            var start = frame.Y;
            var end = frame.Z;
            var depth = frame.W;
            var nodeBounds = nodes.At(node).Bounds;
            var count = end - start;
            if (count <= leafSize || depth >= depthCap)
            {
                nodes = nodes.Set(node, OctreeNode(nodeBounds,
                    SpatialNodeIndex(-1), IntegerInterval(start, end)));
            }
            else
            {
                var center = nodeBounds.Center;
                var keys = new Buffer<Integer>(count);
                var j = 0;
                while (j < count)
                {
                    keys = keys.Set(j, points[perm.At(start + j)].OctantOf(center));
                    j = j + 1;
                }
                var keyArray = keys.Freeze();
                var order = keyArray.SortedIndices((a, b) => a <= b);
                var reordered = new Buffer<Integer>(count);
                j = 0;
                while (j < count)
                {
                    reordered = reordered.Set(j, perm.At(start + order[j]));
                    j = j + 1;
                }
                j = 0;
                while (j < count)
                {
                    perm = perm.Set(start + j, reordered.At(j));
                    j = j + 1;
                }
                var sortedKeys = order.Map(t => keyArray[t]);
                var firstChild = nodes.Count;
                var childStart = start;
                var octant = 0;
                while (octant < 8)
                {
                    var childCount = sortedKeys.Reduce(0, (acc, key) => key == octant ? acc + 1 : acc);
                    nodes = nodes.Add(OctreeNode(nodeBounds.OctantBounds(octant),
                        SpatialNodeIndex(-1), IntegerInterval(childStart, childStart + childCount)));
                    stack = top < stack.Count
                        ? stack.Set(top, IntegerVector4(firstChild + octant, childStart, childStart + childCount, depth + 1))
                        : stack.Add(IntegerVector4(firstChild + octant, childStart, childStart + childCount, depth + 1));
                    top = top + 1;
                    childStart = childStart + childCount;
                    octant = octant + 1;
                }
                nodes = nodes.Set(node, OctreeNode(nodeBounds,
                    SpatialNodeIndex(firstChild), IntegerInterval(start, start)));
            }
        }
        return (root, nodes.Freeze(), perm.Freeze().Map(v => ItemIndex(v)), depthCap);
    }
```
